Minimal unmodified LZO 2.10 LZO1X-999 encoder dependency closure. Only src/lzo1x_9x.c is compiled alongside existing miniLZO 2.10. No configure scripts, filesystem operations, callbacks, dictionaries or downloaded binaries are used. Input and output allocations are bounded in ../safe_encode.c. The existing miniLZO safe decoder supports this LZO1X bitstream. See PROVENANCE.json and ../COPYING.
